item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-ce6ad1c89810d1eb","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"On 17 January 2023, Félix Tshisekedi publicly said M23 had not fully withdrawn from captured areas as required by a November regional agreement, accused the group of simulating withdrawal and redeploying, and again accused Rwanda of supporting the rebels; the conflict had displaced at least 450,000 people.","question_ids":["2B.7","2B.10","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; reports a contemporaneous statement and implementation dispute concerning a peace arrangement.","ruler_attribution":"Tshisekedi made the public allegations and characterized implementation of the peace deal; the source does not establish that he controlled M23 or Rwanda.","limitations":["The source reports allegations and an independently noted inability to confirm some M23 withdrawals; it does not establish the truth of all competing claims.","The source does not document Tshisekedi's subsequent enforcement, negotiation, or corrective actions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b07dfcb8dfce3360","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Amnesty International reported that people in the DRC had been forcibly evicted from homes and farmland to enable expansion of industrial copper and cobalt mining projects, and stated that its annex included correspondence from mining companies and the Government of the DRC.","question_ids":["3B.7","5B.5","6B.3","7B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Published 11 September 2023 and describes conditions and government/company responses relevant to the 2023 period.","ruler_attribution":"The source identifies the Government of the DRC as a correspondent but does not attribute the evictions or a specific decision personally to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The supplied extract does not provide the number of evictions, specific projects, legal findings, or the content of the government's response.","This is an institutional finding about the country and mining projects, not proof of personal presidential direction."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8fd6401cb6e1efe6","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"An ITIE-RDC report commissioned by the DRC's multi-stakeholder group found an urgent need for traceability in artisanal 3T and gold mining, stakeholder dialogue frameworks, better formalization, and reliable statistics; it described the artisanal sector as important to the national economy.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.5","5B.7","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published November 2023 and concerns artisanal and small-scale mining data and governance for 2020–2021.","ruler_attribution":"The report was commissioned by the DRC's multi-stakeholder group; the extract does not attribute its findings or any corrective action to Tshisekedi personally.","limitations":["The extract does not report implementation of the recommended traceability, dialogue, formalization, or statistical measures.","The underlying assessment concerns 2020–2021 rather than only 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2b6ab78e19fb4c56","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"An ITIE-RDC evaluation examined whether extractive companies in Haut-Katanga, Lualaba, and Haut-Uélé fulfilled contractual social and environmental obligations and whether expenditures matched local development needs, using legal compliance, relevance, effectiveness, and impact criteria.","question_ids":["5B.5","5B.7","5B.8","6B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Published March 2023 and explicitly evaluates obligations and expenditures in the 2023 reporting context.","ruler_attribution":"The evaluation was produced by ITIE-RDC; the extract does not attribute company compliance, government enforcement, or corrective action to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The supplied extract states the evaluation's scope and criteria but not its substantive results.","No personal presidential action or outcome is established."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-ab4ab624d0f16009","SRC-19b5122fc9b242f2","SRC-c32b6e060709fb5c","SRC-ec3b9e64e516ede5","SRC-102abd1372311987","SRC-b5123f72c767a5ed","SRC-3281ac767d1805c5","SRC-c9d957ee18a47314"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied documents contain only landing-page metadata, titles, report scopes, or download links; their substantive contents were not included in the supplied units.","No supplied unit establishes a concrete 2023 action by Tshisekedi concerning nuclear or other existential-risk safeguards, electoral administration, macroeconomic policy, social-service delivery, or personal integrity beyond the facts recorded.","No scoring or chapter-level judgment is provided."]}
